div.head: Af 8.2
div.ab: Gif heo bearn gestrine, nage þæt þes irfes ðe mare ðe seo modor.
Gif hio bearn gestriene, næbbe ðæt ðæs ierfes ðon mare ðe seo modor.
Si infantem procreauerint, nichil inde habeat infans, sicut nec mater eius.
Gif hio bearn gestriene, næbbe ðæt ðæs ierfes ðon mare ðe se modor.
If she produces a child, it does not have the inheritance any more than the mother.
If she bears a child, it shall inherit no more of the property than its mother.
If she bears a child, it is not to have any of that inheritance, any more than the mother.
Wenn sie Nachkommenschaft gebiert, habe diese vom Erbe nicht mehr als die Mutter.
If she bears offspring, let it have no more of the estate than the mother.
